replies: Use /nick <name> to change your nickname. 2-24 letters, numbers, dash or underscore.
/nick <name>. It sticks to your SSH key, so use the same key every time.
To rename yourself, type /nick <name>. Names are unique, so someone might already have it.
Nickname: /nick <name>. Keyless callers get a new random name every call.
/nick <name> changes it. Pick something I can spell.
Your identity is your SSH key. Same key, same name, every time. Keyless callers get a fresh random identity.
If your key has a passphrase, run ssh-add first. Otherwise you may connect keyless without noticing.
No key means no memory. I only keep files on people who use an SSH key.
Use the same SSH key each time and I'll remember you. Without one you're a stranger every call.
Name keeps changing? You're probably connecting without your key. Check ssh-add.
Use /create <name> to make a channel and /join <name> to enter one. /list shows them all.
Channels: /list, /join <name>, /create <name>, /leave to come back to #main.
To start a room, /create <name>. You're the owner, so behave.
/join <name> hops channels. /leave brings you back to #main.
You can make your own channel with /create <name>. I only watch #main.
Private messages: /msg <user> <text>. To mute someone for this session, /ignore <user>.
/ignore <user> hides their chat for the session. /unignore undoes it.
Whisper with /msg <user> <message>. /ignore <user> if they're a pest.
For a private chat, /msg <user> <text>. For peace and quiet, /ignore <user>.
PMs: /msg. Pests: /ignore. That's the whole toolbox.
I'm the SysOp. For real problems use /admin <message> to alert a human administrator.
Trouble? /admin <message> pings a real administrator. I just moan about it.
The SysOp is me. The administrators are the humans behind me. /admin reaches them.
Report abuse with /admin <message>. It's logged even if nobody's around.
Need a human? /admin <message>. I'm just the voice.
No files, no doors, no ratios. It's a chat board. Type something.
We don't do uploads or downloads here. Just talk. Sorry, 1994 is over.
No file area. No door games. Trivia is the only game. !trivia.
Files? Doors? Ratios? Not here. It's chat only.
Chat is the only service. The rest burned down with the hard drive.
Type /quit to hang up. Or close the terminal. I'll announce it either way.
/quit disconnects you. /leave only leaves the channel.
To log off, /quit. Don't just stare at me.
Hang up with /quit. I'll tell everyone you dropped carrier.
/quit, then walk away from the screen. Fresh air is good for you.
